source_instruction: i  need fluoide free toothpaste for fresh breath.
query: Oh man, I saw the funniest thing on the way over here earlier—someone’s golden retriever trotted right into the coffee shop, stole a whole blueberry muffin off the pickup counter, and bolted out the door before the barista could even react. I also stopped to pet a tiny tabby cat curled up on a park bench that kept headbutting my hand for scratches, and I remembered I need to pick up laundry detergent on my way home later too, plus drop off that overdue library book about backyard vegetable gardening I’ve had for three weeks. Anyway, I’m looking for toothpaste right now, it has to be fluoride free and work really well for fresh breath, and I don’t want to go over that one for the price.
